integrity: Analytic Taylor and implicit-function proof; exact algebra verified by embedded symbolic code; numerical checks are supplementary. Same-model review only, no external certification.
scientific_limitations: The rank-direction reversal is proved for sufficiently weak positive dependence at each fixed shape, plus a unique equality boundary only locally near (shape 9/2, dependence 0). No global phase diagram, causal conclusion, estimator assertion or independent mathematical validation is claimed. Search-based priority is qualified, particularly by an abstract-only variable-power companion from 2024.
title: A sharp local direction-reversal boundary for power copula predictability
